result: Implement save/backup management behind a serialized BackupService with metadata-backed opaque IDs and integrity fields. Add safe list/download/rename/delete/restore operations, atomic temp-file writes and restore rollback, strict basename/path containment, stopped-server guards, scheduled-backup skip while running, and owner-only destructive actions with CSRF/audit. Extend Saves UI with metadata/download and owner confirmations; retain existing interval/retention settings and add focused traversal/integrity/rollback/role/retention tests.

evidence.outcome: currently lacks mutex, integrity validation, rollback, and safe immutable restore identity
only list/create/restore routes exist; download/delete/rename are absent
scheduled backup can run while server is active and BackupService has no shared stopped gate
SQLite initialization is the least invasive location for backup metadata
settings already contain backup interval/retention; Saves UI lacks lifecycle controls

next_slice.summary: Implement metadata-backed serialized BackupService operations, safe routes/UI controls, stopped guards, retention behavior, and focused tests without unrelated changes.
